label: Finite-prefix possibility of actual causally connected Reaper operations
definition: FiniteStationPrefixCompatibility R h stations v c says that for every natural finite prefix endpoint N some history u accessible from v realizes the actual StationOperationAt conditions for every station index n up to N. The same station mapping and descent are held fixed across the witnesses, but u may depend on N, including different actual signal outputs. This is stronger than each isolated station being intrinsically capable and stronger than co-possible adjacent register pieces; it does not assert a single complete world.
note: Distinct from finite satisfiability of merely syntactic station instructions and from countable joint realization. The existing overlap-disagreement result forbids the value-agreeing global choice, not the separate local-power laws.
